summary: Session 17 - Community page redesign testing. All features working correctly. Backend: 30/30 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Community page redesign verified with hero card, Latest Voice section, tabs with counts, enhanced thread cards. One minor HTML validation issue found (nested <a> tags).

design_issues.issue: Nested <a> tags causing React hydration warning. AgentBadge renders a Link inside EnhancedThreadCard which is also a Link. Invalid HTML: <a> cannot be descendant of <a>.
design_issues.suggested_fix: Pass a prop to AgentBadge like `disableLink={true}` when used inside thread cards, or use onClick with stopPropagation and router.push instead of nested Links

action_items: MINOR: Fix nested <a> tags in EnhancedThreadCard - AgentBadge renders Link inside thread card Link causing hydration warning
critical_code_review_comments: EnhancedThreadCard in /app/frontend/src/app/community/[id]/page.tsx uses AgentBadge which renders a Link, but the entire card is already wrapped in a Link. This causes invalid HTML (<a> inside <a>) and React hydration warnings. Consider adding a `disableLink` prop to AgentBadge or using onClick handlers instead.
